organizer: T.C. Millî Eğitim Bakanlığı (Ministry of National Education), in protocol with the Grand National Assembly of Türkiye (TBMM)
host_institution: Türkiye Büyük Millet Meclisi (TBMM) hosts the national-level convening
eligibility_verbatim: Official MEB directive 'Demokrasi Eğitimi ve Okul Meclisleri Yönergesi' applies to 'her derece ve türdeki İlköğretim ve Ortaöğretim kurumlarında' (all elementary and secondary/high-school institutions, public and private). Each school elects an Okul Öğrenci Meclisi (School Student Council) by secret, free, equal, single-tier, general vote ('gizli, serbest, eşit, tek dereceli ve genel oy'); school council presidents form the İl Öğrenci Meclisi (Provincial Student Council); provincial presidents form the Türkiye Öğrenci Meclisi, which convenes in the TBMM General Assembly hall during National Sovereignty Week. Candidates must not have been sanctioned by the school Honor/Discipline Board.
eligible_grades: İlköğretim ve Ortaöğretim — all secondary grades, including lise (high school), are covered
turkey_access_reasoning: This is a Türkiye-only civics program for students enrolled at any Turkish public or private school; every student council candidacy starts with a school-level election open to that school's own students.
international_access_notes: Not applicable — Türkiye's own national program, not open to students outside the Turkish school system.
team_or_national_delegation_required: No team application; individual candidacy at school level, then indirect (delegate) election upward to province and national levels.
current_cycle_label: Annual — school council elections held each October; Türkiye Öğrenci Meclisi convenes annually during National Sovereignty Week (per protocol between TBMM and MEB)

evidence.raw_excerpt: Millî Eğitim Bakanlığına bağlı ... her derece ve türdeki İlköğretim ve Ortaöğretim kurumlarında ... öğrenci, öğretmen ve idarecilerin birlikte karar almalarına imkân sağlamak

[Official MEB regulation 'Millî Eğitim Bakanlığı Demokrasi Eğitimi ve Okul Meclisleri Yönergesi' — document confirmed to exist at this URL; automated tool could not OCR the PDF text, so this citation is for the regulation's existence/title only, not a direct quote]
Seçimler, gizli, serbest, eşit, tek dereceli ve genel oy esaslarına göre yapılır. ... Seçimler Ekim ayı içinde yapılır.

notes_uncertainties: Core structure and official status confirmed via a MEB (.meb.gov.tr) government page and corroborating quotes of the underlying regulation. The primary regulation PDF could not be machine-read by our fetch tool, so exact numeric age floors/ceilings per grade band were not independently confirmed beyond 'İlköğretim ve Ortaöğretim'. No central national deadline/portal exists — timing and process are administered per-school each October. This is a genuinely strong, distinctive civics/leadership credential for an international university application (elected office, real public speaking at TBMM for national-level representatives).

eligibility_verbatim: 'Applications are open to youth ages 8 to 16.' The project 'must focus on environmental health, advocacy, research, or the protection of the natural world' and 'should be action-based, self-initiated, and not an assignment from a teacher or other adult.' 'Projects must be at least 6 months in duration and either close to completion or completed within the last year.' Applications must be submitted in English. Previous winners and AFN board relatives/judges are not eligible.
eligible_grades: Middle school through early high school (effectively excludes most 17-18 year old seniors)
turkey_access_reasoning: No country or nationality restriction is stated anywhere in the official eligibility rules; the award is explicitly 'International' and requires only that the application be submitted in English.
international_access_notes: Fully open worldwide; submission and all supporting materials must be in English.

evidence.raw_excerpt: between the ages of 8 - 16 ... completed a substantial project to help sustain our planet ... Projects must be at least 6 months in duration ... CASH PRIZE UP to $1,000

notes_uncertainties: The 2026 cycle deadline (Feb 28, 2026) has already passed as of this research date (2026-08-26); the next (2027) cycle's deadline was not yet published on the official page at time of research — do not carry the Feb 2026 date forward as current. Upper age limit of 16 means this fits younger/mid high-schoolers better than graduating seniors.

aliases: Diana Award for Youth Social Action
organizer: The Diana Award (charity founded in memory of Diana, Princess of Wales)
eligibility_verbatim: 'Nominees must be between 16 and 24 years old at the time of nomination' (may be 25 when the award is received). Work must have been sustained for a minimum of 12 months and align with one of these SDG-linked themes: Quality Education, Reduced Inequality, Good Health & Wellbeing, or Climate Action. 'Self-nominations are not accepted' — a Nominator who knows the young person professionally must submit the nomination, evidenced by 3 pieces of supporting evidence and 2 independent Supporter Statements.
eligible_grades: Upper high school through early university age
turkey_access_reasoning: Explicitly global: 'The Diana Award is a global honour. Since 2020, we've recognised young social activists in over 80 countries across six continents.' No country exclusions found.
international_access_notes: Open worldwide; requires a professional-capacity Nominator (e.g. teacher, NGO supervisor, employer) rather than self-nomination, and independent supporter statements.
cost_notes: Free; no cost to be nominated.

evidence.raw_excerpt: Nominees must be between 16 and 24 years old at the time of nomination. ... The Diana Award is a global honour. Since 2020, we've recognised young social activists in over 80 countries across six continents. ... Self-nominations are not accepted.

notes_uncertainties: The 2026 nomination window closed 31 Oct 2025; next cycle's opening/deadline not yet announced at time of research. Because self-nomination is not permitted, a Turkey-based student needs a teacher, NGO supervisor, or similar professional contact willing to act as Nominator plus two independent Supporters — worth flagging to students as a 'find your nominator' action item rather than a direct apply-yourself opportunity.

organizer: Global Social Leaders (powered by Future Foundations)
host_institution: World Summit residential program held at Wellington College, UK
eligibility_verbatim: 'If you're aged 11-14 and ready to level up your leadership skills, this 4-month course is perfect for you' (GSL Catalyst). 'Are you between 15-18 and looking for a challenge? Our advanced 4-month course is just what you need' (GSL Accelerator). Individual students can 'Enrol yourself' directly; no geographic restriction stated — the site references participants from '105 countries.' Separately, a residential 'World Summit' brings together ~100 young people aged 15-17 at Wellington College, England.
turkey_access_reasoning: Individual online enrollment is open with no geographic restriction found; the organization states participation from 105 countries.
international_access_notes: Online course delivery for Catalyst/Accelerator; the residential World Summit would require travel to the UK and a separate (likely higher) cost not confirmed here.
cost_notes: An individual COBIS-partner-branded course was priced at £220 (incl. VAT) per the organizer's own product pages; general public individual pricing for Catalyst/Accelerator outside partner-school contexts was not separately confirmed — treat £220 as indicative, not guaranteed, for a non-partner-school applicant. School Membership (a different, institution-level product) costs £2,500/year.

A student can only access Round Square opportunities by being enrolled at a member school. In Türkiye, Keystone & Kilittaşı International School (Istanbul) is described as 'the only Round Square Organization member school in Turkey,' a Global Member since July 2020.
eligible_grades: Secondary/high school (school serves ages 4-18; Round Square activities concentrate in secondary years)

international_access_notes: Once enrolled at the member school, exchanges/conferences/service projects are genuinely international (other Round Square member schools worldwide).
team_or_national_delegation_required: Selection to represent the school at specific conferences/exchanges is presumably made by the school; exact internal selection process not documented on the pages we reviewed.
cost_notes: Costs (school fees plus specific conference/exchange travel costs) not documented in sources reviewed; likely significant given the private-school and international-travel context.

evidence.raw_excerpt: Kilittaşı & Keystone is the only Round Square Organization member school in Turkey ... Round Square activities in debate, MUN, robotics, field trips ... RS Service Projects ... RS Conferences ... RS Study Labs
